title: Down the Orange Road
text: Engram's drones see us back down the orange road. Behind us the chassis hall's doors stay open on the orange hull. ENGRAM mentions, as if it were nothing, that its harvesters work the sulfur plains of Io-T, and that you would be welcome to watch. Io-T is on the routes.

choices.label: Head home
choices.reply: The lander lifts. Below it the orange road stays lit.

choices.label: Stay a while
choices.reply: We stay. Engram's drones go on walking beside ours, very politely.

notes: onDone of the-works. The Act 2 "Expedition complete" card: Return to Touchdown travels home; Stay keeps playing here (the Command Core lists every route).
